Author: Stwohm (fork of yagi2/Restocker)
Name: Restocky
Punchline: Restocker fork: bulk reprice with price guards, history log and an optional bell auto-cycle.
Description: Personal fork of yagi2/Restocker. Cross-retainer market workbench: reprice every listing to the live market lowest -N gil, bulk-list inventory with stack splitting. Fork additions: fixes for the duplicate-listing queue crash and stale-snapshot row mismatch, price guards (per-item floor, max drop %, outlier skip), a persistent price-history.csv, a one-click full cycle and an optional timed auto-cycle while at the summoning bell.
Changelog: 0.3.13.0 — Sold-out items are restocked at the live market price (game Compare prices), not the last sale; market prices survive plugin reloads. New Runs tab: last 20 runs with what changed, what was skipped and why, copyable. Why tooltip on every Reprice row (decision, guards, floor, bait, scan age). Stock tracking: stock per source (bag, saddlebags, retainers) with freshness (? unread, ! partial), restock mode Default/Auto/Alert (Trial = Alert) with a Next cycle preview, Only low filter, gil/unit labels. Stack top-up respects Per listing; Restock is disabled when there is nothing to do. A sale frees its retainer slot immediately; a full preferred retainer is named in the plan. Fixes: no-result market searches, top-up readback, cross-character sale matching, CSV earning column, restock skips and failures reported. 0.3.12.0 — Low stock is now Stock tracking: Restock tops up a partial listing (withdraws it, merges inventory units, relists the full stack at the same price; setting, on by default); per-item preferred retainer (Sell on); kind (Flip/Gather/Craft) and status (Regular/Trial) tags with filters. Market searches with no results finish at once and keep the price instead of timing out. Steadier ETA. Profit and Earning show the whole listing (quantity x unit), per-unit in the tooltip. 0.3.11.0 — Current updates after Full/Auto cycle reprices; the undercut (!) marker stays until the next scan. Low stock refreshes after Restock/List without Refresh all. ETA for running jobs. Earning (teal) for items with no recorded cost, shown apart from profit. Today's market sales vs ours and a lost-sales list in the (!) popup and Sales tab. [Match bait] chat link and Reprice tab button: one-shot price match against a skipped bait listing. Optional (off by default): auto-restock low stock during Full/Auto cycle; reprice each retainer during AutoRetainer's bell visit (GatherBuddy Reborn friendly, skipped while Auto cycle is on). Safety: floor and price range re-checked before every price write. 0.3.10.1 — Moves Gilhound world and item name lookups off the game thread to reduce frame hitches. 0.3.10.0 — Match quality is on by default, including when upgrading. Turn it off per item to let HQ compete with NQ prices. Set a global default in Settings or override HQ and NQ beside each item's floor. Gilhound Go can search for the item by name when the market board opens on the destination world. 0.3.9.0 — Adds Gilhound travel commands with an on/off switch in Settings. 0.3.8.0 — Settings price floors show the effective floor (cost-based when you have not set one). A floor you type there is the rule, even below cost; Auto button (or 0) returns to the cost floor. One-time cleanup removes old manual floors below the break-even price. 0.3.7.1 — Fix: Update prices and Low stock windows crashed when drawing the price box (NullReferenceException in ImGui.InputScalar). 0.3.7.0 — Automatic break-even floor: when an item's purchase cost is known (market board purchase or manual lot), Full cycle, Auto cycle, I set prices and Low stock suggestions never price below cost / (1 - sales tax), plus an optional minimum profit (Settings: Auto cost floor on, sales tax 5%, min profit 0%). Uses the next FIFO lot, HQ and NQ separately; the higher of this and your manual floor applies, shown in the price tooltip. 0.3.6.0 — Cheap rivals priced like you are no longer dropped as bait; new Max raise limit (default 30%, Settings): automatic cycles skip bigger raises (max_raise), I set prices now follows the same rules (floor, max drop, max raise) and marks guarded rows yellow/orange for review before Apply. 0.3.5.3 — An empty right-click menu while fetching prices is retried (2x) and the row skipped instead of stopping the run; I set prices only fills prices fetched during this visit. 0.3.5.2 — Sale history is requested on every retainer visit (also I set prices + Apply, fetch, restock, refresh); delayed AllaganMarket notices (up to 72 h) and identical stacks now match the history sale; existing duplicate sales are merged automatically at load. 0.3.5.1 — Fix: sale history records were dropped before the retainer was known (now captured also when another plugin opens the history window; diagnostic log lines prefixed '[Restocky] history:'); Fix: market board results from other worlds (world visit) no longer reach the price cache or the (!) tooltip; Update prices table is sortable (default: by item name, so stacks of the same item sit together). 0.3.5.0 — Sales are read from each retainer's sale history during cycles (buyer, time, exact proceeds; toggle in settings); (!) icon in Update prices lists cheaper listings with per-rival 24h/3d/1w undercut counts and the most active rivals; automatic cost basis from market board purchases (FIFO), Profit column and Costs tab; realized profit, Stuck listings and sales Velocity in the Sales tab; suggested low-stock threshold. 0.3.4.0 — Sales are recorded from AllaganMarket's sale message (also fixes listings closed as "gone" within 72 h); Hold checkbox in Update prices: automatic cycles never change a held item's price. 0.3.3.0 — Refresh all updates Low stock counts at once; low stock shown in the tab title and window header; price lines after every run; List & price opens the game sale window and waits for your price. 0.3.2.0 — Per-item price change lines in chat after each cycle; Low stock tab with alerts, market price suggestion (lowest -undercut, Use / Check) , one-click Restock (prefers the retainer that already sells the item), and List & price when nothing is listed (game price window, rest follows). 0.3.1.0 — Auto-advance retainer Talk dialogues, Full cycle (I set prices) button, scrollable plan lists, your price / market lowest beside floors, bait-listing notices, configurable chat channel (default Retainer Sale). 0.3.0.0 — Listing lifecycle and competitor tracking, AutoRetainer coordination, materia name fix, editable interval.
